RimMandrake.WeepingStones.RM_FactionSlot.label: condenser buyer
RimMandrake.WeepingStones.RM_FactionSlot.description: A wealthy collector who wants the old gorrask alive for its fighting pit. Non-hostile; fallback: the most advanced non-hostile faction.

RimMandrake.WeepingStones.RM_FactionSlot.label: condenser settlers
RimMandrake.WeepingStones.RM_FactionSlot.description: Farmers who live by the old gorrask's water. Non-hostile; fallback: the friendliest non-hostile faction at or below industrial tech.

RimMandrake.WeepingStones.RM_FactionSlot.label: condenser hunters
RimMandrake.WeepingStones.RM_FactionSlot.description: Trophy hunters who want the old gorrask's shell for the boast. Hostile; fallback: a permanent-enemy faction first.
